cards.prompt: Which gene explains why many East Asians have less body odor?
What do people with the ABCC11 gene not secrete through apocrine glands?
cards.answer: They don't secrete protein-rich sweat; bacteria breaking it down causes odor.

cards.prompt: Where are apocrine sweat glands mainly found?
Explain like I'm 10: how does sweat turn into body odor?
cards.answer: Some glands make a sweat full of protein, especially when you're stressed. Bacteria on your skin break it down, and that makes the smell.

cards.prompt: Which food does NOT make body odor worse?
cards.answer: Spinach contains chlorophyll that can neutralize odor; the others can worsen it.

cards.prompt: Why can jengkol cause bad breath and strong body odor?
cards.answer: It has a high concentration of sulfur-rich amino acids, similar to garlic and onion.

cards.prompt: Cutting out junk food and sugar can change your body chemistry and reduce odor.
cards.answer: Fact: healthier eating improves gut health and means fewer toxins in skin and sweat.

cards.prompt: You have an important date and want to smell less. Based on diet, what do you avoid and what do you eat or drink?
cards.answer: Avoid curry, cumin, garlic, onion, alcohol and fish. Prefer water, leafy greens like spinach, herbs like mint and parsley, and citrus fruits.
